comparison: node tools/compare-visual-evidence.mts on the exact committed bytes of both revisions: Pixelmatch threshold 0.1, anti-aliasing included, no resizing or masks. A mismatch count locates change; it does not measure quality.

minimaps.method: Prepared 640 x 320 minimap per lens at the reference revision and in the branch working tree; sheets show reference, branch and diff at 480 x 240.

contexts.method: Manifest-pinned context snapshot per body at the reference revision and in the branch working tree; the sheet shows reference, branch and diff at 256 x 256.
